Ivy (Docs): Drafting the relnotes for the upcoming docs push. Scope: snippet cleanups, a couple of 404 anchors, and a small streaming edge-case QA found. I'll open the PR in ~15m.

Noah (SDK): Can you paste the exact snippet refs that are failing so I can grep the examples?

Ivy (Docs): Found two: `snippet:embed-deprecated-async` in guides/embeddings/quickstart.md and `snippet:chat-flow-step3` in tutorials/chat/guide.md (anchor renamed). I'll add paths in the PR body.

Rina (I18N): Our localized branches (pt/zh) still reference the old anchors. I can update them after the final anchor name lands to avoid rebasing twice.

QA-Bot: Issue filed: #8270  embed streaming may omit the final token for very short prompts on canary. Repro script attached.

Owen (Eng): Confirmed. The canary runtime flush order can split the final token when max_tokens <= 7. Patch in progress targeting next micro-release. Recommend a Known Issue entry and a brief workaround.

Pri (Docs): Suggested relnotes copy: "Known issue: short streaming sequences on canary models may omit the final token. Workaround: set max_tokens >= 8 or use stable models." Add repro steps and logs.

Noah (SDK): I'll open a tiny PR with TODO stub snippets to keep snippet-check green while docs make canonical fixes.

Ivy (Docs): PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7123  title: "Relnotes: snippet tidy, anchor redirect, streaming note". Draft contains three bullets, brief examples, repro steps, and a localization anchor `#known-issues-v1-4-0`.

QA-Bot: CI results: docs/lint: pass, snippet-check: fail (2 unresolved refs), link-check: fail (1 404).

Noah (SDK): Stub PR #7124 merged with TODOs for the two missing snippets. Re-running checks.

QA-Bot: All checks passing on PR #7123 after stubs merged.

Rina (I18N): I'll rebase translations and open the i18n PR once anchor `#known-issues-v1-4-0` is live.

Owen (Eng): If QA wants a short canary window to validate the repro, ping me and I'll spin up staging canary for 20 minutes.

Pri (Docs): Added rollback contact `#eng-oncall` and a one-line rollback playbook to relnotes. Planning merge tomorrow 09:00 PT and announcement after deploy.

Ivy (Docs): merging in 10 unless objections. Thanks all! :tada:
